purpose: Public historical birth facts for local calculation/clock sensitivity checks, never biographical prediction fitting.
sourceLimit: Astro-Databank pages and source notes were read in the browser. Their AA/A ratings describe their collection, not independent inspection of an original certificate by SUJI. Store factual fields and short source descriptions only.

cases.name: Elizabeth II
cases.sourceDescription: Source notes cite an official announcement and The Times, London, 22 April 1926, p.14. The page specifies daylight time UTC+1.
cases.uncertainty: Published time is minute-resolution; original contemporary newspaper not independently inspected.

cases.name: Elvis Presley
cases.sourceDescription: Collector reports certificate/record in hand and a doctor's log at 04:35; notes also record a conflicting family recollection of 03:30.
cases.uncertainty: 04:35 is the record-backed working input, not a guarantee; 03:30 retained as a sensitivity variant.

cases.name: Diana, Princess of Wales
cases.sourceDescription: Source notes describe a Buckingham Palace letter dated 13 April 1981 relaying her mother's 19:45 recollection; earlier 14:00 reporting is also documented.
cases.uncertainty: Family recollection, not certificate-grade; both reported times are tested without rectifying against her life.

cases.name: John F. Kennedy
cases.sourceDescription: Source notes cite his mother's recollection and several biographies; one says shortly after 15:00. The page specifies standard time UTC-5, not modern May daylight time.
cases.uncertainty: Rounded family memory near an hour-branch boundary; +/-30 minute sensitivity is essential. A later astrologer's 15:17 rectification is excluded.
